attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. None of the corpus's women of this name is a Russian nun of Pereyaslavl: `thecla-the-protomartyr`, `thecla-of-aza`, `thecla-of-alexandria` and `thecla-of-gaza` are all of them ancient and eastern. Her son, Daniel of Pereyaslavl, whom the page keeps on 7 Απριλίου, has no folder, so he is named without a link. The page's «Κόρη του Αυτοκράτορα Θεόφιλου» is the site's gloss on the *name* Thecla and not a statement about her, and is not carried into the folder. No year, no hymn.
